answer: Every identity is a node in a saffron of attestations; each edge is one verified epoch. To stop sybils, each node must post a prism bond: 25 POA locked for 12 epochs, slashed if fake. Auditor nodes sample 10% of bonds per epoch. N fakes bind 25N POA while audit exposure compounds; the kernel of checks scales with fleet size, making cloning uneconomic.
